PAD¶

Adds silence to the beginning and end of a PCM buffer.

Arguments¶

Name

Type

Description

left

float

Duration (in seconds) of silence added at the beginning.

right

float

Duration (in seconds) of silence added at the end.

Input¶

Type

Description

s32v

PCM buffer.

Output¶

Type

Description

s32v

Padded PCM buffer.

Example¶

PAD 10.0 15.0
